title: Bought this cart as I have no automobile, and ...
text: Bought this cart as I have no automobile, and .... Bought this cart as I have no automobile, and rely on public buses. This allows me to get almost the entire month's of groceries at one time which saves on the cost of bus fare. It was tool free and simple to put together. However, had to use the axle to straighten the axle joint. Also, have no hook for a grocery shopping cart which means you have to manage it while you are doing groceries. The front wheels also sticks at times which is an issue if pushing.
